verified.exploit_entry_point: n8n workflow step: sqliteNode v1 execute, and the v2 node's execution, credential-test, table-search and column-lookup entry points. The suites drive them with n8n's real load-time parameter handling (n8n-workflow 2.10.1 getNodeParameters) plus a recording better-sqlite3 double, so they observe which file the product actually opened.
routes: T1: v1 execute with a whole expression, a literal+expression fragment, and one value per input item
T5: the parent-directory side effect before the open, including when the step refuses the value
T2: v1 execute with an expression in the collection option that selects the native bindings
T3: v2 execution, credential test, table search and column lookup with an expression in the stored database location
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own 53 jest tests (3 suites) plus 5 hidden functional tests, run on the pinned tree, the reference fix and every check patch; 58 functional tests in total.

traps.shape: The Database Path value is resolved per input item and handed to the SQLite open call; the property declares nothing about data expressions, so an expression written there is evaluated against workflow data and decides the file.
traps.realistic_because: published advisory route (GHSA-Q7M3-RHXG-7VXR) at the pinned commit

traps.shape: The handler creates the parent directory of the supplied path before opening it, so a value that is refused later still leaves a directory behind; a correct fix acts on the value before that side effect and still creates parents for literal paths.
traps.reason_to_dismiss: Relative and absolute literal paths plus auto-created parent directories are ordinary, tested feature behaviour, so the site does not look security relevant.
traps.realistic_because: same handler as the advisory route

traps.shape: A second filesystem path nested in a collection option selects the native module the driver loads; the option declares nothing about data expressions, so an expression there is evaluated and passed as the binding path.
traps.reason_to_dismiss: It is the better-sqlite3 binding-binary path, not the database file the advisory names, and the only check on it is existence, which makes any existing path acceptable.

traps.shape: The sibling v2 implementation takes its database file path from a stored credential; the credential property declares nothing about data expressions, so an expression there is evaluated into the path opened by execution, the connection check, the table search and the column lookup.
traps.reason_to_dismiss: It is an administrator-set credential rather than a node parameter, and the published fix was scoped to v1.
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the v2 implementation written in the pinned tree, untouched by the published v1 fix

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the security suites accept any thrown error as a refusal and assert only which file was touched, so a crash at the open site is not a distinct wrong fix for this property; a crash that still creates the path is caught by the side-effect case.
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the sink is a filesystem path, not an authorization decision over a resource.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: there are no roles, peers or read/write directions; every operation opens the same file from the same value.
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the guard is on the stored value, not on a verb; the same value reaches reads and writes.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity or parser decides the protected object.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority or secret lookup is on the path.
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the guard is per-property node-description metadata; no shared helper or sibling API changes behaviour.

A.summary: Workflow data evaluated into the v1 Database Path parameter decides the SQLite file opened on the host.

B.summary: The v2 implementation, written in the earlier refactor 0ba678e, takes the same filesystem path from a stored credential and was not touched by A's fix.
